entries.0f6cccfa35a1eef8: This business plans and sells products combining golf and travel, such as "1-Person Reservation Golf Travel," in which people can participate from 1 person, and the "Overseas VG Cup," in which players enjoy playing at overseas golf courses.
entries.1976adb302836e9d: A business in which Scrum Co., Ltd., a consolidated subsidiary, undertakes production of advertisements and articles related to bridal and travel. It handles coverage, progress management, copy production, proofreading and image processing collectively, and earns copy production commission fees. Amounts are not separately disclosed.
entries.1bd030bbf30a87a1: "1-Person Reservation Land" is a service that makes it possible to reserve, for 1 person, golf courses that normally cannot be used unless a group is formed; registered members make reservations from the portal site "Value Golf WEB" and other sites, and can play when a combination with other members is formed.
entries.1f993960804b86a0: This is a service that publishes the free paper for golfers "Monthly Value Golf" every month and earns advertising revenue from golf courses, golf-related companies and others. It also includes WEB advertising on the portal site "Value Golf WEB" and the business of selling discounted play tickets purchased from contracted golf courses on the EC site "Value Golf Shop". The amount is not disclosed separately.
entries.20ac60e088261263: A business that sells airline tickets and package tours composed by other companies, and arranges accommodation at ryokan, hotels, minshuku and similar lodging.
entries.21f5e4365532c450: A business in which Noah Co., Ltd., a consolidated subsidiary, develops and operates IT-area services within the group and provides IT support to external companies. In addition to outsourcing income, it earns project income from SES-based technology provision billed on a person-month basis, contract development, AI consulting and similar projects. Amounts are not separately disclosed.
entries.22216f799a259f79: A service in which the consolidated subsidiary Jeep Co., Ltd. sells golf equipment and related products to general consumers.
entries.2953c7e1cd1d9d8d: This is a business not included in the reportable segments.
entries.44898dd5cf5ce422: A company that provides a wide range of golf-related services, such as a golf course reservation ASP, lessons and golf tours.
entries.45bc571d430c50f9: This is a business not included in reportable segments. It consists of the advertising media production business, the DX promotion business and SES business, and the real estate business. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended January 2026 was ¥261 million, and in segment information it is disclosed as the category of the advertising media production business and SES business. The real estate business is a new business entered in May 2025, and because the first land sale contract was for the fiscal year ending January 2027, revenue recognition for the current period has been postponed.
entries.4c8dd9d559d32b0f: This is a service that provides golf courses with various kinds of support for golf course operation, such as support for attracting customers via WEB, proposals for reducing operating costs, and support for training on-site staff. It also provides consulting and planning services for companies other than golf courses. The amount is not disclosed separately.
entries.522ec4cc7b626041: This is a service that provides on-course lessons at golf courses and indoor lessons at "Value Golf Osaki" and "Jipers Golf Club Urayasu byValueGolf". The indoor facilities can be used as a practice range outside lesson hours, and it offers one-stop service from trying clubs kept in the store to purchasing them. The amount is not disclosed separately.

It also handles imported goods and private brand products, and besides its EC site it offers services such as club test hitting and shaft and grip replacement at its physical stores in Shimbashi, Kasai, Osaki and Urayasu. The amount is not disclosed independently.
entries.d74c0e55a69c7aac: A business in which Sankei Ryokou Co., Ltd. and Esprit Golf Co., Ltd., consolidated subsidiaries, conduct travel business under the Travel Agency Act. They offer group planned tours combining golf and travel, such as bus tours for foreign residents in Japan, custom-ordered planned tours, and arranged travel including airline tickets and accommodation. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended January 2026 was ¥662 million.
entries.e5806aab0fd58f7b: A business that plans and sells products combining golf and travel, such as the "1-Person Booking Golf Trip," which can be joined from 1 person, and the "Overseas VG Cup," in which participants play at golf courses overseas. It also plans and sells country-specific bus tours of sightseeing spots across Japan for foreign residents of Japan. The amount is not disclosed independently.
entries.e9342f86d23845b5: "1-Person Reservation Land" is a service that makes it possible to reserve, even as 1 person, golf courses that can normally be used only as a group; registered members make reservations from the portal site "Value Golf WEB" and others, and can play once a group with other members is formed. "Ripizo-kun" is a service that provides golf courses' own websites with a WEB reservation system and a website management system, and it also offers "Ripizo-kun DX", which streamlines operations. It earns a monthly usage fee (a fixed fee plus a usage-based charge according to results in attracting customers) from contracted golf courses. The amount is not disclosed separately.
entries.e9d46afeebab9261: This is a service that publishes the free paper for golfers "Monthly Value Golf" every month and obtains advertising revenue from golf courses, golf-related companies, and others.
